biggest_catch: Adobe's official pages confirm an active Campus Ambassador program with points-based rewards, but publish no point values, no dollar amounts, and no guaranteed compensation — the named rewards are swag, tech, and unspecified 'bonuses', which the rules require be rejected.
catches: Official Adobe Express page: 'Ambassadors earn points for every task they complete on behalf of Adobe and can cash their points in for Adobe-branded swag, the hottest tech, gift cards and more!' — no point values or dollar amounts anywhere.
Another official Adobe page promises only 'Gift cards, bonuses, and surprise rewards' — amounts and conditions unstated.
No concrete, guaranteed compensation is published; per the rules, ambassador roles offering only swag/product/credits/unspecified incentives must be rejected.
